answer: Subnet-capped deposits: each new account locks 5 POA for 30 epochs, and one network block may hold only 2 open deposits, so a gale of signups from one gateway queues. An honest user locks 5 POA; 1,000 fakes need 5,000 POA frozen across 500 blocks. Renting proxies so the farm does not ripple from one range still costs 500 paid addresses, and frozen stake cannot be reused between waves. Auditors replay public funding data every 10 epochs and burn 50% of deposits sharing a source, so one ember of linked stake loses 2.5 POA per account.
